desc: Ideate approaches and select boundary-mask DP over safe intervals.
Attempt boundary-mask DP; abandoned because too complex/token-heavy.
Attempt residue-minimal DP; incomplete due token limit, but approach viable.
Implement concise interval-residue DP with precomputed residue offsets and offset_to_interval propagation.
Validate on samples and edge cases: M=0, A=B, A=1, adjacent bad intervals, very short safe intervals, skipping intermediate safe intervals, and N in the last safe interval.
If concise interval-residue DP fails sample tests, switch to another compressed approach (e.g., important-position graph or BFS with periodicity) rather than polishing the same code.
